heading: Immunity of United States Government
lead: The United States Government is not liable for any debts, defaults, acts, or omissions of the foundation. The full faith and credit of the Government does not extend to any obligation of the foundation.

notes.text: Amendments2014—Pub. L. 113–237 renumbered section 152610 of this title as this section.
